svg.title: Formal transport and one finite coefficient domain
svg.desc: For H prime exp(u squared), source u=0 and slope p0=1 are transported to u=w, slope exp(-w squared), and second derivative f(w)=-2w exp(-2w squared). The plots sample w from -1.2 to 1.2 in 481 points. The formal series f has zero constant term and nonzero linear coefficient -2. The coefficient map therefore extends to a fraction field when p0 is nonzero.

g.text: Formal transport and a finite source-slope domain
Nonzero series are invertible in the field.
Ranks and symbol identities at the original jet
481 samples of each displayed analytic formula.
